title: Canonical affine spectrum comparisons commute with the bare mate
statement: For commutative squares f,fprime,g,gprime of affine schemes and their spectrum maps, and K in D(O_X), the actual base-change map followed by the direct-image coordinate comparison at Lgprime*K equals the constructed source coordinate comparison followed by spectrum pullback of the spectrum base-change mate followed by the direct image of the canonical pullback coordinate comparison. No second coefficient object or coefficient morphism is present. The coordinate isomorphisms are the explicit conjugation construction of def-pc-affine-spectrum-direct-image-coordinates.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit definition of base change; Tag 0D5S, Lemma 20.27.2, pullback composition

proof.text: In a proved private categorical helper, expand the source-coordinate component with the whiskering and associator app equations. The helper keeps the source natural isomorphism as a parameter and uses its defining equality, so its component does not require unfolding the scheme coordinate construction. Evaluate the spectrum mate under the pinned adjunction and postcompose its evaluation by counit naturality with the inverse-spectrum pullback comparison.

Pullback of the candidate spectrum-coordinate composite, followed by the transported counit, can be evaluated using naturality of the forward spectrum comparison. Apply pullback-square coherence to its square-comparison part, then move the spectrum counit in the reverse direction across the forward comparison for gprime. Comparison cancellation removes the inverse unit and counit compatibility for f identifies the remaining composite with the defining transpose of the original mate.

Counit compatibility for fprime identifies the transported counit with pullback of the inverse direct-image coordinate map followed by the original counit. Postcompose both sides of the desired equation by that inverse, cancel the coordinate hom-inverse pair, and apply injectivity of the inverse adjunction Hom equivalence. The previous evaluation equals the defining original-mate evaluation, proving the equation.

proof_origin.place: Remark 08HY, counit transpose; Tag 0D5S coherence. A fully proved categorical coordinate-mate helper is instantiated with the exact canonical choices; the defining source-iso equality is reflexivity.

theorem affineSpectrum_baseChange_mate_compatibility
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (h0 : Spec.map g'.appTop ≫ Spec.map f.appTop =
      Spec.map f'.appTop ≫ Spec.map g.appTop)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h K ≫
        (affineSpectrumDerivedDirectImageIso f').hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
      (affineSpectrumBaseChangeSourceIso f g).hom.app K ≫
        (derivedPullback S'.toSpecΓ).map
          (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
              (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) h0
              (affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K) ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f'.appTop)).map
              ((affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').hom.app K))
